comment: The decision is made by a first-order Markov chain over articulations combined with context: the size and direction of the interval, the beat strength, the position in the phrase, how far the previous note has died away, the scale degree, and whether the slide physically fits in the time available. Hard physical limits are applied last as outright refusals, so no knob setting can buy an impossible articulation. The temperature control is kept off the panel on purpose, because what it actually does is convert committed slides into hedged ones and into rests rather than trading sliding for attack.
